author: Bobby Grayson
description: Also found: duplicate builder goals under a round root when orchestrator-created goals coexist with builder-created ones arriving via sync, three of which reached no outcome (now rejoined: 641->588, 636->589, 633->597). And a correction to my own report: elixir/real/table_registry.ex is byte-identical to the loom original with NO module-name change at all; the translator handles the dotted name Loom.Teams.TableRegistry itself.
title: Round 6 verifier refused to run the instructed 'git checkout -- .deciduous/deciduous.db' because it detected a concurrent round-7 session's nodes 647-666 in the live db; restoring would have destroyed in-flight graph work. Correct judgment over instruction. Protocol fix: verifiers must never restore the graph db, and read-only deciduous commands should not dirty it
